usage: 星期三 is a noun used to refer to the day Wednesday in a week.
You can use 星期三 to specify when an event will occur, e.g., 'I have a meeting on 星期三.'
星期三 can be combined with dates to provide more exact information, such as '星期三，三月十日' (Wednesday, March 10).
When talking about weekly routines, 星期三 is often used like other weekdays to describe habits or repeated actions.
星期三 functions just like other weekday nouns and can be used as a subject or object in a sentence.
